title: Apply the dimension-1 transfer to X102's readers
body:
## Summary
- X102 has 16 dimension-1 readers among the 2,309 compatible edges. Those edges all use X102's initial line.
- The dimension-1 relation joins exactly the edges on one line, so those 16 readers form a clique. One read-first transfer leaves X102 on those same 16 edges.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The dimension-2 relation is not built.
